name: godspeed
description: An agent harness for learning: adaptive teaching, practice, and a persistent knowledge graph.

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-resources.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,ui "cargo build -p gs-server && cd .dev-resources && PORT=$((${PORT:-3000}+1000)) LH_DATA_DIR=\"${LH_DATA_DIR:-$INIT_CWD/data}\" ../target/debug/godspeed-server" "vite"
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/dev-resources.mjs && cargo build -p gs-server && concurrently -k -n ui,app "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "TAURI_APP_PATH=crates/shell tauri dev"
scripts.desktop:local: node scripts/fetch-model.mjs && node scripts/fetch-pdfium.mjs && node scripts/compile-icon.mjs && TAURI_APP_PATH=crates/shell tauri build -c crates/shell/tauri.bundle.conf.json -c crates/shell/tauri.bundle.macos.conf.json --bundles app --no-sign
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run deadcode && npm run rust:check
scripts.rust:check: cargo test --workspace && cargo test -p gs-shell --features screens --bin godspeed screens:: && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p gs-shell --features screens --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p gs-shell --features self-test --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo machete
